nodes.name: Finalize Status Decision
nodes.notes: Create vs update branches: update existing lead (recapture Fresh except Converted); create only when mirror has no phone.

nodes.name: Upsert Document
nodes.notes: Canonical phone-keyed replacement with upsert. Node v1.3 fails when phone is missing instead of silently filtering the item.

nodes.name: Push Update to TeleCRM

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Finalize Status Decision').first().json || {}; const fields = { phone: d.telecrm_push_phone, status: (d.should_push_name && !d.should_push_telecrm) ? (d.telecrm_push_status || d.conversionStatus) : d.conversionStatus, name: d.name }; if (d.dash_patient_id) fields.dashboard_field = d.dash_patient_id; if (d.dash_email) fields.email = d.dash_email; return JSON.stringify({ fields }); })() }}

nodes.notes: UPDATE branch: status on the phone already stored on the lead. No 91 prefix.

nodes.name: TeleCRM Status Changed?
nodes.notes: UPDATE branch gate: status change or a real name replacing the Lead placeholder

parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const p = $('Check Status & Extract').first().json.phone10; const match = { phone: { '$in': [p, '91' + p] } }; return JSON.stringify([{ '$match': match }, { '$limit': 1 }]); })() }}

nodes.name: Remove Legacy Root CTWA
nodes.notes: Enforces the canonical new-telecrm allowlist and removes all legacy fields, including final_source.

nodes.name: Lead Found in TeleCRM?
nodes.notes: True = update branch. False = maybe create branch.

nodes.name: Should Create Lead?
nodes.notes: Create branch gate: no existing TeleCRM lead + new join row or dashboard status change.

nodes.name: Push Create to TeleCRM

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Finalize Status Decision').first().json || {}; const fields = { phone: d.telecrm_push_phone, status: d.conversionStatus || 'Fresh', name: d.name }; if (d.dash_patient_id) fields.dashboard_field = d.dash_patient_id; if (d.dash_email) fields.email = d.dash_email; if (d.telecrm_push_source) fields.source = d.telecrm_push_source; return JSON.stringify({ fields }); })() }}

nodes.notes: CREATE branch: only when mirror has no lead. Uses 10-digit phone (no 91) so website leads do not duplicate.

nodes.name: Re-read User Profile
nodes.notes: Reads the user again immediately before upsert so a phone-verification stub named Lead cannot overwrite the saved name.

parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const id = String((($('Build Full Document').first().json) || {}).dash_patient_id || ''); if (!/^[a-fA-F0-9]{24}$/.test(id)) return JSON.stringify([{ '$match': { '_id': { '$exists': false } } }]); return JSON.stringify([{ '$match': { '$expr': { '$eq': [{ '$toString': '$_id' }, id] } } }, { '$limit': 1 }, { '$project': { email: 1, 'profileData.firstName': 1, 'profileData.lastName': 1, 'profileData.gender': 1, 'profileData.dob': 1, 'profileData.status': 1 } }]); })() }}

nodes.name: Require Fetched User
nodes.notes: Fail loudly instead of ending as a successful no-op when the trigger ID cannot be resolved.

nodes.name: Verify new-telecrm Write

parameters.query: ={{ (() => { const input = $input.first().json || {}; let finalized = {}; let extracted = {}; try { finalized = $('Finalize Status Decision').first().json || {}; } catch (_) {} try { extracted = $('Check Status & Extract').first().json || {}; } catch (_) {} const phone = String(input.phone || finalized.phone || extracted.phone10 || '').replace(/[^0-9]/g, ''); if (phone.length !== 10) return JSON.stringify([{ '$match': { '_id': { '$exists': false } } }]); return JSON.stringify([{ '$match': { phone } }, { '$limit': 1 }]); })() }}

nodes.notes: Read the row back through the same Mongo credential immediately after upsert. Mongo errors fail the execution.

nodes.name: Require new-telecrm Write
nodes.notes: Do not report success or call TeleCRM unless the canonical join row can be read back.

nodes.name: Source Differs?
nodes.notes: True when source[0] exists and is not already the TeleCRM source dropdown.

nodes.name: Push Earliest Source

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ (() => { const d = $('Finalize Status Decision').first().json || {}; return JSON.stringify({ fields: { phone: d.telecrm_push_phone, source: d.telecrm_push_source } }); })() }}

nodes.notes: Source only. Omits status so this call cannot reopen a lead.

nodes.name: Wait for TeleCRM Lead
nodes.notes: Gives TeleCRM's own website lead time to land before deciding to create.

nodes.name: Re-check TeleCRM Lead
nodes.notes: Live TeleCRM lead/search (Sync token). Errors stop the run so a failed lookup never creates a duplicate.

nodes.name: Still No TeleCRM Lead?
nodes.notes: True = TeleCRM search returned no lead after the wait, so create one.
